A foreign princess who became an imperial consort (Bắc Địch (northern steppe) princess). Hair: her own hairstyle, NO braids and NO side braid, decorated with several gold hairpins (trâm) with dangles, rich like her rank. No phoenix anywhere on the robe or in the hair: only flowers, birds, butterflies or other motifs. The silk has real weight: the wide sleeves and robe hang and fold naturally under their own weight, with natural creases, never stiff, flat or board-like.
